narrative_purpose: Full-bleed atmospheric mood layer behind the chapter: an immense dim violet forest seen from far above, setting the feeling of a whole biosphere quietly running the same arithmetic in every leaf.
subject: An ultra-wide panoramic Pandoran vista from a very high vantage: an endless violet and indigo forest canopy stretching to the horizon far below, its surface broken by drifting banks of luminous haze and threaded here and there with the faintest veins of cyan glow. No single bright focal subject — only the slow dim luminosity of vegetation spread across an entire landscape.
scene: A high ridge overlook at deep dusk, the forested basin receding for miles into layered atmospheric haze, two very dim distant suns implied low near the far horizon without becoming bright points.
camera: An extreme wide, high-vantage panoramic view, distant and contemplative, horizon low.
light: Very low overall; scattered faint bioluminescent glows in the far canopy as the only real light, deep indigo-teal atmosphere swallowing the distance, no bright highlights anywhere.
palette: Dominated by void-indigo and deep teal with muted violet in the canopy, only sparse dim cyan glow below; deliberately dark and low-contrast throughout.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate, atmospheric, hand-painted depth.
detail_level: Soft and low-contrast throughout; everything dissolving into atmospheric haze, no crisp focal element anywhere in frame.
composition: Wide horizontal panorama with deep atmospheric layers, low horizon, vast dark sky above, all glow kept faint and distant — built to sit behind long-form text.
consistency_notes: Cool Pandora palette, dark and atmospheric, intentionally low-contrast as a background layer; nothing bright enough to compete with overlaid text.
